payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation (NMT) systems, including data augmentation techniques and subword segmentation.

claims.text: Data augmentation methods are employed to increase the amount of training data, helping NMT systems cope with low-resource situations.
Subword segmentation allows NMT to learn to translate words with considerably fewer data, addressing data sparsity.
The mix-source method is considered useful for alleviating data sparsity in low-resourced settings.
